programs.title: Intern for a Day
programs.description: Intern for a Day takes HAVK members off campus and inside a company to see the work, the people, and the paths into the industry up close.
programs.details: The Spring 2026 visit to TIAA ran from 9:30 AM–1:30 PM with transportation provided. Students met employees, explored teams and career paths, and completed a professional-readiness workshop before the visit.

programs.title: Algorithmic Markets
programs.description: A Principal Financial-funded, semester-long technical project that gives HAVK students room to work on a difficult problem together instead of stopping at a one-night workshop.
programs.details: Students explore quantitative finance, predictive modeling, edge AI, real-time analytics, and how algorithmic markets make decisions as conditions change. Workshops feed into a collaborative technical build, research, and a final presentation of what the team learned.

programs.title: AWS Technical Writing
programs.description: Turn a project, research idea, or something you just learned into a technical article you can actually publish and share.
